author: Zaki
title: title 1
body: 1- Artificial Intelligence is rapidly shaping our modern world. From smartphones to self-driving cars, AI is becoming an essential part of everyday life. Experts believe it will soon transform industries like healthcare, education, and business, creating new opportunities while also raising ethical questions.
